content.text: Stripe operates in 46 countries out of 195. PayPal suspends accounts in Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan—holding funds for 180 days. Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad, and Paddle inherit these restrictions. If you’re a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-broken-here-2|digital]] creator in a locked-out region, your infrastructure problem is structural: you need base-layer commerce tools that do not depend on any single payment processor. This breakdown compares conventional platforms to sovereign commerce stacks—where ownership, automation, and payment verification sit entirely in your control.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Conventional platforms like Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad, and Paddle offer hosted storefronts with integrated payment processing. They handle file delivery, customer emails, and tax calculations. However, they depend on Stripe or PayPal for payments—meaning their availability mirrors these processors’ country restrictions. Sovereign commerce stacks, in contrast, use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-9|Crypto Payment]] payment verification. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. No platform dependency. No subscriptions. Full infrastructure sovereignty.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Lemon Squeezy and Gumroad explicitly block signups from restricted countries. Even if you use a VPN to create an account, payment processing fails without a supported Stripe or PayPal account. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely. NOWPayments accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC, no buyer account required, and a flat 0.5% fee. Transactions confirm on-chain—not through a centralized processor. Your store operates in any country with internet access. No platform can suspend your account or hold your funds.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Lemon Squeezy and Gumroad charge 5% to 10% per transaction plus payment processor fees. PayPal holds funds for up to 21 days in some regions—180 days if suspended. Sovereign stacks using NOWPayments verify crypto payments on-chain within minutes. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. Your only recurring cost is the 0.5% NOWPayments fee. No platform cuts. No fund holds. No country-based restrictions.
Stripe operates in 46 countries. Sovereign commerce stacks operate in 195.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms own your customer data, product files, and transaction history. They can suspend your account or change their terms at any time. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership. Orders store in your [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-complete-infrastructure-13|COREMERCH guide to supabase]] database or Google Sheet. Product files deliver from your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 bucket. Automation runs on your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script. After deployment, COREMERCH has no access. You control the infrastructure. You set the terms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in a Stripe-supported country with no risk of payment processor suspension, conventional platforms offer convenience—at the cost of ownership and control. If you’re in a restricted region, or if you prioritize infrastructure sovereignty, sovereign commerce stacks provide a permanent structural alternative. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments in 48 hours—with 5 products loaded, email authentication configured, and end-to-end testing. Choose renting convenience or owning infrastructure.

This architecture bypasses centralized payment processors entirely. Transactions confirm on-chain, and you retain full ownership of your store, data, and funds. No platform dependency. No country restrictions.
